AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-backend#661 @ bc399edd5911c9c1e83e4bb1051fde05bfeda64d — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

A/B/C = 0/1/1

Lens: AUD-SOL-661D-120, agent 120. Independent T4 conflict-resolution/main-refresh delta from the prior own-model approval; all recurring additions in the two conflicted checkout files and every remerge conflict hunk were read, with recurring invoice ownership, native credential publication, replay/error envelopes and transaction/CAS/lock boundaries traced. This is not an inherited other-lens approval. [Refresh record](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/661#issuecomment-5998643247)

## B-661-14 — composed recurring activation keeps the spent PaymentSheet credentials at rest

**Where:** `src/checkout/checkout-webhook-handler.service.ts:1637–1651` (`applySubscriptionUpdated`) and `2292–2302` (`applyInvoicePaid`). The two actual recurring activation writes set entitlement/status/trial markers but omit `CLEARED_PAYMENT_SECRETS`; the merged PaymentIntent success early-return correctly delegates recurring activation to these invoice/subscription paths, so its one-time credential erase no longer covers this purchase. The resolved end helper does clear credentials, but activation does not. [Exact composed handler](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/bc399edd5911c9c1e83e4bb1051fde05bfeda64d/src/checkout/checkout-webhook-handler.service.ts#L1637-L1651) [Invoice write](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/bc399edd5911c9c1e83e4bb1051fde05bfeda64d/src/checkout/checkout-webhook-handler.service.ts#L2292-L2302)

This is the previously deferred C-661-3 **required second-to-land composition**, not unrelated scope expansion: #661 is now second, and its stated promotion trigger requires credential clearing on recurring `invoice.paid -> active/trialing`, not only subscription deletion. [Recorded composition contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/661#issuecomment-5977850515)

**New exact-composed-tree counterexample / execution:** pending native recurring purchase stores first-invoice PI `client_secret` and customer ephemeral key; deliver `invoice.paid` or `customer.subscription.updated` through the real handler in a real PostgreSQL transaction. The purchase becomes active/entitled and has one activation marker, but both synthetic credential canaries remain. The same two event paths for a card-confirmed native trial set `trialing`, entitlement and `trial_started_at`, yet retain the spent SetupIntent secret and ephemeral key. [New independent CI acceptance](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37341623338)

**Minimal fix / verification:** erase both fields in the same locked transaction that confirms finished recurring payment/card-save activation, on both invoice and subscription-event owners; keep the unconfirmed/card-unsaved trial's payable SetupIntent and first-attempt retry credentials. Preserve recurring status, one-time-only recovery, row/package locks, revision/CAS fences, trial-consumption markers and exactly-once fanout/settlement. Add these four failing-before/passing-after acceptance cases plus open-attempt/no-card controls to the tests piece #702, without exceeding #661's grandfathered 3,000-line ceiling. No historic cleanup or production write is authorized by this finding. [Credential lifecycle contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/bc399edd5911c9c1e83e4bb1051fde05bfeda64d/src/checkout/admin-purchase.select.ts#L30-L40)

## Prior findings / evidence applicability

- Sol B-661-1/2/3/8/9 remain repaired at their retained boundaries: status-first replay/loser polling, complete owner-before-cap query, xmin stale-evidence fence, owning-PI/status CAS, NO KEY UPDATE, terminal authority and nonpayment drop takeover. Their latest independent PostgreSQL/native-owner/mixed-owner/concurrency/rollback probes are replayed on this exact composed source. Obsolete round-3/4 doubles are superseded by the retained canonical row-version/recovery regressions, rather than executed with missing current interfaces. [Prior own-model approval](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/661#issuecomment-5982350850) [Fresh replay](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37341623338)
- Admin omit, dunning omit, value/key redaction, fanout takeover/restore, round-5 regression spec and the three-line live-gate extension are byte-identical to the prior own-model approved inputs. #702's two test blobs are unchanged, its remerge has no conflict resolution, and #702 runtime/schema/dependency/workflow inputs equal #661. The final clean main merge changes no tree: `010f9b57` and `bc399edd` both have tree `dccedddf8069bf8510400abe63a52b0fa6b10424`. Evidence reuse is bounded to those unchanged inputs, not blanket prior approval. [Prior approval](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/661#issuecomment-5982350850) [Current restack](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/702#issuecomment-5998643507)
- Recurring PI-success/decline early returns precede the one-time fences, subscription deletion preserves unpaid-attempt expiry/churn/trial semantics while clearing both credentials, and one-time reply errors plus recurring reply codes still reach the HTTP envelope. No recurring event was converted to one-time `paid` recovery or a second settlement owner. [Composed implementation](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/bc399edd5911c9c1e83e4bb1051fde05bfeda64d/src/checkout/checkout-webhook-handler.service.ts) [Replay composition](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/bc399edd5911c9c1e83e4bb1051fde05bfeda64d/src/checkout/checkout.service.ts)

## C-661-13 — carried optional truthful replay copy

`src/checkout/checkout.service.ts:87–96,128–144` still promises ready package access from prior payment status without proving current entitlement/window. Keep the completed-payment code/credential fence, use entitlement-neutral copy or verify actual access, and add unentitled/expired controls. Per freeze this remains a ticket, not another unrelated builder edit. [Prior own-model finding](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/661#issuecomment-5982350850)

## CI / evidence limits / recommended default

Fresh lane: **typecheck SUCCESS; 39 suites, 4 failed / 545 passed, zero skipped**. Only the four new credential-erasure assertions fail; all 38 other suites pass, including the previous Sol PostgreSQL/native-owner/mixed-owner/concurrency/rollback probes, hosted/live settlement, replay/admin/drop/fee controls and recurring R1–R7 regression suites. The first command contained two nonmatching control paths; those two suites are not counted as executed there and are run with corrected `src/**/__tests__` paths in the separate control lane. [Independent replay and negative proof](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37341623338) [Separate control lane](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37342234566)

The first lane is tests-only commit `3fc0689f` plus wrapper `5c63eb90d2c3b895e6ce1d35f352c4522fe77107` on exact #702; only tests/setup/typecheck marker/wrapper differ, with no production/schema/dependency change. Disposable runner PostgreSQL, real Prisma/handler/fanout/coach-decision services, doubled Stripe/ancillary calls; not production, real Stripe, HTTP/RLS/migration or release acceptance. [Independent lane](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37341623338)

Supplemental control lane: **typecheck SUCCESS; 3 suites, 4 failed / 22 passed, zero skipped**. The same four credential assertions fail; the corrected first-payment/refund-decision suites and the new card-unsaved trial controls pass, including a Stripe default card whose create-time end remains set. Thus blindly clearing every `trialing` row would break a real payable-attempt control. This lane adds only strengthened tests on the same exact composed source (`532dfce6b4134b0cfd858a3cbb1b2af141f28ead`, wrapper `13c21eb81dc1facdfea7ea10e9e46290ed643ebb`). [Supplemental controls](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37342234566)

Both candidate heads remain unchanged and the base is main `ee55f814eb02b530e6578a168dc16c7ea7e2b07b`; #661 is 2,849 changed lines (847 source / 1,999 tests / 3 workflow), grandfathered below 3,000. All **11/11 required candidate-head checks are SUCCESS**; green candidate CI does not waive the new independent acceptance failures. [Exact #661 CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37244459604)

Recommended default: no merge; one bounded B fix and restack, replay both lenses' probes, obtain both new exact-head verdicts, then land #702/#661 together under rule 11 with all main-required contexts on the combined bottom candidate. C-661-2 historic cleanup stays approval-only in the deploy window, preserving still-payable native trialing/incomplete attempts rather than blindly reusing the old one-time status predicate; C-661-10 association/index and stale-body Cs stay follow-ups. C-656-1's separate recurring/trials ledger/capability/webhook composition remains owned by the later trials stack, not certified or changed by this secrets audit. [Existing obligations](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/661#issuecomment-5977850515) [Trials integration contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/673#issuecomment-5977778572)
